# The dimension types of an Analysis Services server: what the members of a dimension stand for. One row per type,
# in the order of the enumeration DimensionTypeEnum of the Analysis Services Scripting Language.
# name: the type as the schema spells it. number: its place in that enumeration, counted from 0.
# dimension_type: the code as an Analysis Services server reports it (MDSCHEMA_DIMENSIONS.DIMENSION_TYPE), the one
# the specification [MS-SSAS] names. A dimension of the type Regular is reported as 3 (other); the measures dimension
# has no type and is reported as 2 (measure).
